text: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax_id, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value. Source activities, assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno. Filter by target chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1293266', standard_type = 'IC50', standard_relation = '=', and pchembl_value IS NOT NULL. Sort by molecule ChEMBL ID ascending and assay ChEMBL ID ascending. Limit 1000.
